rules.statement: A settlement or compromise must comply strictly with the provisions of sections 91 and 408 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) Where there has been a settlement or compromise it must be in strict compliance with the provisions of section 91 and section 408 of the Civil Procedure Code. (2) It is possible for parties to a partition action to compromise their disputes provided the court has investigated the title of each party and satisfied itself as to the respective rights and allotment of shares upon the compromise reached by parties

rules.statement: Parties in a partition action may reach a compromise regarding their disputes if the court has verified each party's title and confirmed the allocation of shares based on such compromise.
